description: The CSIC Instituto Pirenaico de Ecologia and Estacion Experimental de Aula Dei publish a global drought monitor for maize, wheat, barley, soybean and cotton regions. SPEI grids have 0.5 degree spacing, weekly updates and accumulation periods from half a month to 48 months, with history from 1979. The service uses ERA5 meteorology and provides a public map, point graphs and NetCDF download links. The DataCite record of its DIGITAL.CSIC deposit states ODbL-1.0 (read on 2026-09-28); the draft had CC-BY-4.0. The map and NetCDF links are free to use. The live map displayed September 2026 conditions when checked. SPEI represents meteorological water balance, not observed crop loss, irrigation delivery or reservoir storage, and coarse cells limit local interpretation. The product can provide drought scenarios for agricultural water-demand and food-supply simulations. It complements data-era5-reanalysis with standardized crop-region indicators. Downloaded values and the calculation chain were not independently checked.
